name: media-split-band
purpose: One claim beside its picture, on its own frame: the copy cell with its overline, headline and sentence on one side, and the media on a raised, pixel-textured surface on the other. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'media-split-band', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, a framed `media-split`, `button`, `code-block`, `illustration`, `product-widget`, `diagram` and the webkit scene assets. The media is a scene, a code sample (one file or a tab strip of files), a product console widget, a request-flow diagram, an image (cover or framed) or an illustration; with one action the whole band links to it (unless `linked` is off), with two the band stays unlinked. The media sits beside the copy, or under it when `orientation` is `vertical`.
useWhen: Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → the section (`media-split-band`). Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the primitive (`media-split`).
Use MediaSplitBand for one marketing claim beside its picture, scene or code.
To make one point beside one picture and move on (a values statement, a single product claim).
To set a claim beside the code that delivers it (`codeTabs`), with the files in a tab strip.
avoidWhen: For several claims stacked one after the other → use `media-split-stack`.
For a full-width terminal session with no copy column → use `cli-terminal`.
For copy beside one piece of media in a hand-built SFC that needs the `media` slot → use `media-split`.
related: media-split` — the band primitive the section is rendered with.
media-split-stack` — the stacked sibling for a run of claims.
bestPractices: Give the band exactly one media: `scene`, `codeTabs`, `widget` (a `ProductWidget` name), `diagram` (a `Diagram` name), `image` or `illustration`; when several are set the first of that order wins.
A code sample holds controls of its own (tabs, copy), so the band never links to its lone action while it shows code; give it a `kind: 'transparent'` action for a quiet "Learn more".
On a product page prefer `widget` or `diagram`: they show the product itself. Do not drop to `media-split` and its `media` slot to place one.
Set `image.framed` for a picture that is an object rather than a scene (a badge, a logo, a screenshot): it sits whole on a rounded, bordered plate inset in the cell instead of covering it.
Use `size="large"` for a band that carries only its headline and description.
Use `orientation="vertical"` for a wide scene that needs the full width of the frame under the copy.
Turn `linked` off when the media holds controls of its own, so a click in it is not taken as a click on the band.
Set `anchor` when another part of the page links to the band.
Give an `image` its `width` and `height` so the page reserves its box before it loads.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the media split as its `h2` and naming its region; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: size
props.doc: Type scale of the copy; `large` sets the headline at heading-xl and centres the copy beside the media, `medium` aligns it to the top of the media.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Axis the band splits on; `vertical` stacks the media under the copy for a wide scene.

props.name: texture
props.doc: Texture painted under the media: `dots`, `grid`, `lines`, `dither`, `pixelate` or `none`.

props.name: linked
props.doc: Links the whole band to a lone action; turn it off when the media holds controls of its own.

props.name: scene
props.doc: Scene drawn in the media cell, `{ component, props? }` naming a webkit scene asset and the props bound onto it; wins over every other media.

props.name: codeTabs
props.doc: Files of the code sample drawn in the media cell when no scene is set, in order; each is `{ label, value, code, language?, fileName?, fileIcon?, icon? }` where `icon` is a mark beside the tab label. A tab without `code` is skipped.

props.name: defaultFile
props.doc: value` of the code tab open first; empty, or a value no tab carries, opens the first tab.

props.name: copyAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the code sample's copy button; empty keeps the code block's own.

props.name: widget
props.doc: Name of the product console widget drawn in the media cell when neither a scene nor code is set.

props.name: diagram
props.doc: Name of the request-flow diagram drawn in the media cell when neither a scene nor a widget is set.

props.name: image
props.doc: Picture drawn in the media cell when no scene, widget or diagram is set; `{ src, alt?, width?, height?, framed? }`, where `framed` sets it whole on a rounded plate instead of covering the cell.

props.name: illustration
props.doc: Registry name of the illustration drawn in the media cell when no other media is set.

props.name: illustrationAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the illustration; empty keeps it decorative.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the copy; `{ label, href, trailing?, icon?, target?, kind? }`. When it is the only action it renders outlined with a trailing chevron, and the whole band links to it (not over code); `kind` overrides the drawn kind.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second, outlined button beside the first; `{ label, href, trailing?, icon?, target?, kind? }`. With two actions the band stays unlinked.

<script setup>
  import MediaSplitBand from '@aziontech/webkit/media-split-band'
</script>

<template>
  <MediaSplitBand
    eyebrow="Our values"
    title="Four values shape every role at Azion"
    description="Quality, Drive, Accountability, and Innovation. They guide how we work every day: we set high standards and measure what we deliver, take on hard problems with persistence, own our commitments and mistakes, and use AI and new technology to solve problems in new ways. Together, they help us earn and keep the trust of our customers."
    size="large"
    :scene="{ component: 'BrandGlobeScene' }"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Product media
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import MediaSplitBand from '@aziontech/webkit/media-split-band'
</script>

<template>
  <MediaSplitBand
    eyebrow="Real-Time Events"
    title="Filter every request as it happens"
    description="Narrow the event stream by status, path or country, and read the matching requests seconds after they arrive."
    widget="real-time-events-filter"
    :primary-action="{
      label: 'Learn more',
      href: '/en/products/real-time-events/',
      trailing: true
    }"
  />
  <MediaSplitBand
    eyebrow="Cache"
    title="Serve repeat requests from the nearest location"
    description="Cached responses never travel back to your origin, so it handles a fraction of the traffic."
    diagram="cache"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Code
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import MediaSplitBand from '@aziontech/webkit/media-split-band'

  const codeTabs = [
    {
      label: 'cache-settings.json',
      value: 'cache-settings',
      language: 'json',
      code: '{\n  "cache_settings": {\n    "name": "api-cache",\n    "browser_cache_settings": {\n      "ttl": 60\n    },\n    "cdn_cache_settings": {\n      "ttl": 30\n    },\n    "cache_key": {\n      "query_string": "whitelist",\n      "query_string_fields": ["user_id", "category"],\n      "cookie": "whitelist",\n      "cookie_names": ["session_id", "region"]\n    },\n    "methods": ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],\n    "stale_cache": true\n  }\n}',
      fileName: 'cache-settings.json',
      fileIcon: 'ai ai-json'
    }
  ]

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Learn more',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/build/applications/application-accelerator/',
    trailing: true,
    kind: 'transparent'
  }
</script>

<template>
  <MediaSplitBand
    title="From basic caching to advanced acceleration"
    description="Application Accelerator extends Cache with protocol optimizations and advanced cache rules for dynamic content."
    :code-tabs="codeTabs"
    copy-aria-label="Copy the cache settings sample"
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
  />
</template>
